scope: Resolve ten named Indian Sixth Schedule institutional scope questions only; primary constitutional/own/state/Union evidence. No broadcast validation or publication.
decision_method: Project classification based on substantive autonomous territorial lawmaking, finance and executive accountability. Constitutionally limited or nested authority is not rejected solely for sitting below state level; a council title or government-directory local-body category is not decisive.

sixth_schedule_2026.finding: Article 244(2) and the Sixth Schedule establish autonomous territorial councils. Paragraph 3 covers land, non-reserved forest, inheritance, marriage/divorce and custom; Assam has extra grants in 3A/3B. Laws require assent and official publication. Paragraphs 7/8 provide funds, tax powers and CAG reporting to councils;13 requires discussion of relevant state estimates. Paragraphs 15/16 allow intervention. These are bounded legislatures, not sovereign states.

assent_and_supremacy.assam: Paragraph 3(3) as amended,3A/3B and12: Governor assent; concurrent-list measures reserved to President; state-law application follows the scheduled subject rules.
assent_and_supremacy.meghalaya: Paragraph 3(3),11,12A: Governor assent/publication; conflicting Meghalaya legislation prevails to the stated extent.
assent_and_supremacy.tripura: Paragraph 3(3),11,12AA: Governor assent/publication; scheduled subjects have specific state-law application arrangements.
assent_and_supremacy.mizoram: Paragraph 3(3),11,12B: Governor assent/publication; scheduled subjects have specific state-law application arrangements.

sixth_schedule_2026.scope_inference: Substantive territorial legislation plus finance/executive control satisfies the maintained special-status legislature rule. This is an explicit project judgement, not a claim that each council is a state legislature under Article 168.

constitution_2026.title: Government of India, Legislative Department: Constitution of India, as on 1 May 2026
constitution_2026.version_scope: Preface dated 1 May 2026; incorporates amendments through the 106th Amendment Act, 2023. Sixth Schedule including state-specific footnotes read; no claim of certification of every later instrument.

assam_btc_governance.title: Assam Administrative Staff College: Governance in Bodoland Territorial Region
locators: slides 2–5: constitution, powers and legislative assembly
slides 7–10: fund devolution, plans and budget
slides 14–15: fund rules, annual accounts and audit
assam_btc_governance.finding: State training material distinguishes BTC legislative assembly and executive machinery, council approval of its own budget and annual plan, state appropriation/grants for entrusted functions, and laying CAG reports before the assembly. Institutional powers evidence; slide seat counts and officeholders are not adopted as a fresh roster.

kaac_current.title: Karbi Anglong Autonomous Council: own institutional page
kaac_current.finding: Page names KAAC as a Sixth Schedule self-governing institution and describes legislative, executive and judicial functions. October 2026 administrative notices appear alongside an older footer date; neither certifies every incumbent or enactment.

nchac_current.title: North Cachar Hills / Dima Hasao Autonomous Council: own institutional page
nchac_current.finding: Header retains North Cachar Hills Autonomous Council; page also uses Dima Hasao Autonomous Council and says it is a Sixth Schedule district council. A Dimasa Kachari Customary Law Bill, 2026 is listed as uploaded 1 October 2026. A listed Bill is not proof of assent or commencement; inconsistent historical/member-count snippets are not used as current metadata.

khadc_intro.title: Khasi Hills Autonomous District Council: jurisdiction
khadc_intro.finding: Own introduction identifies the constitutional council and its executive, legislative and judicial remit across the Khasi Hills autonomous area, encompassing multiple present civil districts. It distinguishes traditional Hima/Elaka units below it.

khadc_land_act.title: Khasi Hills Autonomous District (Regulation and Administration of Land) Act, 2021
khadc_land_act.finding: Council passed this land-tenure enactment on 10 November 2021; Governor assented 30 August 2022; gazetted 2 September 2022. Section 22 subjects specified executive difficulty-removal action to council approval; section 23 provides for rules. This is enacted territorial land legislation, beyond an ordinary service bylaw.

meghalaya_rules.title: Assam and Meghalaya Autonomous Districts (Constitution of District Councils) Rules, 1951, council-hosted compilation
meghalaya_rules.finding: Rule 22 explicitly makes the Executive Committee collectively responsible to the District Council and removable by a council no-confidence vote. The web reader rejected the 10.6 MB file size; this is a reader limit, not an institutional absence. Compilation is structural evidence and is not represented as a complete 2026 amendment consolidation. Normal local download then timed out after 45 seconds; no complete local text read is claimed.

jhadc_current.title: Jaintia Hills Autonomous District Council, Jowai: own site
jhadc_current.finding: Government-hosted council page names JHADC, its chairman and executive offices and carries September/October 2026 notices. Direct web-reader requests timed out. Indexed content corroborates name and continued institutional presence; no claim of fresh direct retrieval or certified present membership.

jhadc_cag.title: Comptroller and Auditor General: Jaintia Hills Autonomous District Council, year ended 31 March 2018
jhadc_cag.finding: Historical auditor description distinguishes a legislative secretary, council-elected Chief Executive Member and Executive Committee, with council district-fund accounts. Direct PDF returned 404; this is scoped indexed auditor evidence for the recorded period, not a fresh complete PDF read or 2026 audit finding.

meghalaya_2025.title: Meghalaya District Council Affairs Department: General Elections, 2025
meghalaya_2025.finding: State page lists separate KHADC and JHADC election/result and executive-member notifications. It corroborates distinct institutions; the direct web-reader timed out and the 2025 notices are not a guarantee of every October 2026 officeholder.

ghadc_current.title: Garo Hills Autonomous District Council: own institutional site
ghadc_current.finding: Own page identifies GHADC under Article 244(2)/Sixth Schedule, based in Tura, across five civil districts. It carries 19 August 2026 judicial recruitment notices and an executive-secretariat contact. Administrative notices corroborate the institution, not continuous elected sittings.

ghadc_acts.title: Garo Hills Autonomous District Council: Acts, Rules and Regulations
ghadc_acts.finding: Council law index includes land/revenue, land transfer, forest, marriage, social-custom and taxation enactments, as well as village/town committee laws. Index read; no claim that every listed historical law or amendment was independently revalidated.

tripura_cag.title: Comptroller and Auditor General: Tripura Tribal Areas Autonomous District Council, 2018–19
tripura_cag.finding: Auditor distinguishes the original 1979 statute/1982 council from Sixth Schedule operation beginning April 1985, and discusses own lawmaking, transferred functions, funds and budget controls. Historical financial observations are retained as historical, not a 2026 performance assessment.

tripura_current.title: Akashvani / News on AIR: TTAADC oath-taking notice, 24 April 2026
tripura_current.finding: Government broadcaster reports the council CEO notice for newly elected members and chairman/Chief Executive Member selection. It supports 2026 institutional continuity, not a verified October roster or all subsequent events.

cadc_current.title: CADC passes budget for 2026–27,24 August 2026
cadc_current.finding: Council reports its11th council emergency-session sitting, executive presentation, house discussion and voting on local-receipt reappropriation and grants. This directly demonstrates legislative budget control and a dated sitting; it does not certify all later sitting or executive status.

cadc_laws.title: Chakma Autonomous District Council: gazetted allocation of business rules
locators: legislative department and law/judicial department allocations
cadc_laws.finding: Gazetted allocations distinguish legislative business from executive administration and identify customary-law, inheritance and judicial functions. This is a historical organisation instrument, not a whole current law consolidation.

mizoram_department.title: Mizoram District Council & Minority Affairs Department: MADC Acts & Rules
mizoram_department.finding: State department names Lai, Mara and Chakma as separate autonomous councils and links their own sites. It retains MADC constitution/conduct-of-business, fund, executive and town/village legislation. The MADC 2002 PDF and own MADC root returned 403; no access restriction was bypassed.

mizoram_acts.title: Mizoram District Council & Minority Affairs Department: gazetted Act & Rules index
mizoram_acts.finding: State index separately lists Mara marriage/divorce 2024 and non-agricultural land-settlement 2011 enactments, and Chakma agricultural-land 1982 and land/revenue 2002 Acts. Search-index content read; direct reader returned 403. Enactment titles support substantive subjects; their entire current text was not read.

ladc_structure.title: Lai Autonomous District Council: institutional history and functions
ladc_structure.finding: Own account distinguishes Lai/Pawi from Mara/Lakher, describes the lawmaking council, separate executive/legislative secretariats, taxes and executive answers to member questions. It is a history/structure page, not a validated current seat or officeholder list.

ladc_rules.title: Lai Autonomous District Council (Constitution, Conduct of Business etc.) Rules, 2002
locators: budget chapter, PDF pp 59–65: grants and refusal/reduction
ladc_rules.finding: Rules expressly separate legislative, executive and judicial functions; the house can remove the executive on no-confidence and refuse/reduce district-fund demands. This principal 2002 text is used for the operative institutional architecture, not unamended current seat counts; later amendments require their own metadata versioning.

fnta_revised_bill_2026.title: Nagaland Gazette, 15 September 2026: revised Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority Bill, 2026
fnta_revised_bill_2026.version_scope: Part V, Bill publication under Rule 72, notification AS/LEG-22/Bill/FNTA/2026/298 dated 1 September 2026. This is a revised Bill, not evidence of gubernatorial assent or commencement.
locators: clauses 10–12: territorial lawmaking resolution, state examination, Governor assent and publication
fnta_revised_bill_2026.finding: Revised Bill expressly includes legislative powers and a house resolution process over transferred subjects; Governor assent and gazette publication are required. State direction, grants, audit and suspension remain. Original March executive-only wording cannot decide the revised institution. Full issue contains image-based body text: a negative text-search result is not an absence finding.

fnta_march_statement.title: Nagaland DIPR: Chief Minister statement on FNTA Bill, 27 March 2026
fnta_march_statement.finding: Records constitutional concerns about conferring legislative powers through state law and deferral of the original March Bill. This precedes the revised September Bill and is not used as a final exclusion.

fnta_september_statement.title: Nagaland DIPR: Rio calls FNTA a step towards inclusive and equitable development
fnta_september_statement.finding: Body describes the Chief Minister commending the revised Bill for consideration/passing on 3 September 2026. CMS admin date says 3 August 2026, conflicting with the body; the legal Gazette controls Bill identity/date. Neither date label supplies a final assent or commencement instrument.

nagaland_acts_directory.title: Nagaland State Portal: Act & Rules directory
nagaland_acts_directory.finding: Directory read through current listed items; no FNTA Act entry identified. Incomplete directory coverage is not proof no assent or notification exists.

nagaland_later_gazette_index.title: Nagaland Printing & Stationery: Gazette 30 September 2026
nagaland_later_gazette_index.finding: Official index/download identified. Web reader rejected 11.3 MB file; normal downloads timed out after 45 and 120 seconds without a usable PDF. No statement about the issue contents or absence of FNTA Act is made.

legal_basis: Sixth Schedule paragraph 12 as amended for Assam
records.finding: Eligible autonomous territorial legislature within Assam. Preserve BTC as the constitutional council and its legislative-assembly formation; do not add an independent state or a duplicate legislature for the BTR geographic name. The broader constitutional subject grant and separate legislative budget control satisfy project scope.
records.identity_and_currentness_note: Council name retained as BTC; BTR names its territory. A 2020 political settlement is not treated as self-executing enlargement of every constitutional grant or council seat count.
records.legal_existence_scope: Constitutional institution and subject powers confirmed; this pass does not certify each current member, term, suspension order or actual sitting.

legal_basis: Sixth Schedule paragraph 12 as amended for Assam
records.finding: Eligible autonomous territorial legislature within Assam. Its constitutionally enumerated additional subjects and separate legislative/executive organs meet the project test; ordinary town and village institutions beneath it are not included by this decision.
records.identity_and_currentness_note: Keep KAAC distinct from the statutory Karbi Welfare Autonomous Council for Karbi communities outside its area. Do not equate civil-district subdivision with creation of another council.
records.legal_existence_scope: Constitutional institution and subject powers confirmed; this pass does not certify each current member, term, suspension order or actual sitting.

records.legal_existence_scope: Constitutional institution and subject powers confirmed; this pass does not certify each current member, term, suspension order or actual sitting.

records.legal_existence_scope: Constitutional institution and subject powers confirmed; this pass does not certify each current member, term, suspension order or actual sitting.

records.finding: Eligible autonomous territorial legislature within Meghalaya. It is a distinct constitutional district council with a legislative wing, council-selected executive and district fund, rather than a civil-district administration or a municipal board.
records.identity_and_currentness_note: Keep it separate from KHADC and from East/West Jaintia Hills civil administrations. Historical auditor findings and 2025 state notices are dated structural corroboration, not a 2026 elected-member certification.
records.legal_existence_scope: Constitutional institution and subject powers confirmed; this pass does not certify each current member, term, suspension order or actual sitting.

records.finding: Eligible autonomous territorial legislature within Meghalaya. Own law index corroborates land, forest and social-custom legislation under the constitutional grant; council/executive accountability is recorded by the regional conduct-of-business framework.
records.identity_and_currentness_note: One autonomous council encompasses five civil districts. Its institutional existence in law is retained without asserting uninterrupted elected operation, a current term, or the current force of every historical listed Act.
records.legal_existence_scope: Constitutional institution and subject powers confirmed; this pass does not certify each current member, term, suspension order or actual sitting.

records.original_candidate_name: Tripura Tribal Areas Autonomous District Council
records.current_inventory_name: Tripura Tribal Areas Autonomous District Council
records.finding: Eligible autonomous territorial legislature within Tripura. Constitutional territorial lawmaking and a distinct council budget/executive structure clear the scope gate; it is not simply the sum of ordinary village committees.
records.identity_and_currentness_note: Preserve the historical 1979 statutory origin/1982 operation separately from Sixth Schedule operation from 1985. Proposed Tipra Territorial Council naming or expansion is not adopted without an enacted operative instrument.
records.legal_existence_scope: Constitutional institution and subject powers confirmed; this pass does not certify each current member, term, suspension order or actual sitting.

records.finding: Eligible autonomous territorial legislature within Mizoram. Territorial lawmaking plus a directly documented house vote on executive financial proposals clears scope; constitutional assent and state grant controls do not make it merely an advisory council.
records.identity_and_currentness_note: Retain council-in-law independently of periods of Governor administration. The 24 August 2026 sitting report is dated confirmation, not certification of the executive or electoral situation on every subsequent date.
records.legal_existence_scope: Constitutional institution and subject powers confirmed; this pass does not certify each current member, term, suspension order or actual sitting.

records.identity_and_currentness_note: Lai/Pawi and Mara/Lakher are separate successor identities; never map Pawi to Mara. Do not copy principal 2002 membership figures over later amendments or infer current operation solely from historical rules.
records.legal_existence_scope: Constitutional institution and subject powers confirmed; this pass does not certify each current member, term, suspension order or actual sitting.

records.identity_and_currentness_note: Own-site 403 and unavailable 2002 PDF do not erase a clear constitutional grant. Current elected composition/activity remains unasserted. Avoid the apparent Pawi-to-Mara error in one historical CAG introductory snippet; current Constitution and state/own Lai account distinguish Lai/Pawi and Mara/Lakher.

inventory_reconciliation.action: Add ten eligible special-status institutional rows nested in Assam 3, Meghalaya 3, Tripura 1, Mizoram 3, preserving original scope candidate IDs in a crosswalk.
inventory_reconciliation.counting: These ten are separate autonomous territorial councils, not ten extra first-level states and not state upper houses. Existing 31Assembly jurisdictions plus six Council chamber children remain distinct grains.
identity_corrections: North Cachar Hills/Dima Hasao is one institution.
Bodoland Territorial Region is territorial naming, not a second council.
inventory_reconciliation.class_boundary: This decision covers the ten constitutionally defined Sixth Schedule autonomous territorial institutions. The maintained first-level and autonomous special-status scope excludes ordinary village/municipal bodies, Fifth Schedule advisory representation and routine statutory welfare/development councils; it does not require an exhaustive census of all such below-tier bodies. A newly operative territorial legislature would receive a specific review.
inventory_reconciliation.future_or_proposed_instruments: Political accords and reported proposals to expand/rename councils are not treated as operative constitutional amendments without enacted instruments.
inventory_reconciliation.new_or_changed_territorial_instruments_s: One precise additional 2026 territorial lead was checked: FNTA. Revised September Bill confirmed, final assented/operative instrument not retrieved; record one specific authority-evidence hold separately from the ten resolved Sixth Schedule bodies.

additional_precise_territorial_leads.name: Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority (FNTA)
additional_precise_territorial_leads.finding: A concrete revised territorial Bill exists and provides substantive normative powers; institutional eligibility in force cannot be certified from that Bill or political statements. Preserve as one exact statutory-currentness hold, not as an ordinary-village exclusion and not as an eleventh Sixth Schedule council.
